summary: Elicio Therapeutics filed an 8-K on September 14, 2026, disclosing that its board set November 12, 2026 as the date of the 2026 annual meeting, a change of more than 30 days from the prior-year anniversary. Because the meeting is delayed more than 60 days, the company set a September 24, 2026 deadline for Rule 14a-8 stockholder proposals and Rule 14a-19 universal-proxy director nominations. No deal terms, advisors, or board recommendations are stated; this is a routine meeting-notice and nomination-deadline filing, not a special situation.
